nodes.title: Packs travel outside the box
nodes.text: Flight packs ride in a LiPo bag (E2), not in the box; the aircraft in the box is the gate mass less one pack
nodes.basis: LiPo transport practice (E2 owns); keeps the loaded box under 6 kg

nodes.title: Design drop is flat on the floor
nodes.text: The 0.3 m sill drop is designed for a flat floor impact; side, end and corner impacts are checked by test only
nodes.basis: a box slipping off a sill lands on its floor or a bottom edge; edge drops rotate the box and load less (ISTA practice)

nodes.title: Lid pillars stop the rebound before the upper tube ends reach the lid
nodes.text: After the floor drop the aircraft rebounds into the two PE hold-down pillars; they arrest it before the upper tube ends and foot pads close the 10 mm static gap to the bare lid shell, so the lid needs no lining
nodes.basis: EST: rebound at e = 0.5 from 2.43 m/s gives ~1.1 J on 2.05 kg; two 100 x 60 mm PE pillars ~0.23 m tall at ~40 kPa over 15 mm (5 preload + 10 gap) store ~3.6 J (3x). T-D7-BOX-DROP checks it: chalk on the upper motor caps, no mark on the lid

nodes.title: Cradle crush column: stroke, load factor, free travel
nodes.equation: s_use = eps_use t ; n_T = 1 + h / (eta s_use) ; s_bottom = eps_bottom t ; travel_req = s_bottom + margin ; t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use)

nodes.title: Box stack-up: height needed, clearances, drop allowed by the 0.50 m box
nodes.equation: floor = shell + doubler ; lid = shell + lining ; H_req = floor + travel_req + env_z + gap_min + lid ; travel = H - floor - lid - env_z - gap_min ; clear_bottoming = travel - s_bottom ; x_clear = (W - 2 shell - env_x) / 2 ; tip_to_pad = (L - 2 shell - env_y) / 2 - pad ; A1 box: t_max = (travel_A1 - margin) / eps_bottom, h_allow = (n_allow - 1) eta eps_use t_max

nodes.title: Cradle saddle and pillar footprint against C2 and the brace anchors
nodes.equation: A_saddle = w (x1 - x0) ; side_min = min(w, x1 - x0, hx, hy) ; gap_brace = y_anchor - (y_c + max(w, hy, fy) / 2)

nodes.title: Handle bolt load and wall bearing behind the 140 x 30 mm backing strip
nodes.equation: F_bolt = m_loaded (2 g) / 2 ; p = 2 F_bolt / (0.140 x 0.030)

Box mass and loaded mass
nodes.equation: shell = areal (1 + flaps) [L W + 2 (L + W)(H - t) + L W + 2 (L + W) lip] ; box = shell + doublers + lining + pads + cradles + tray + straps + handles + backing + corners + consumables ; loaded = box + (gate - pack) + spare props + pouch

nodes.title: Field set-up time, closed box to the arm check

steps: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (hold-down pillars come with it)
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its feet on the mat
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, CW/CCW colour-matched to the motor
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes
take a pack from the LiPo bag, seat it, strap it
close the pack plug, FC boots

nodes.title: Crush-column coupon test
nodes.procedure: Two 60 x 50 x 120 mm PE columns under a 2.05 kg dummy on a saddle; drop 0.3 m onto concrete, phone accelerometer on the dummy (>= 400 Hz app); 1.7 and 2.2 pcf; pick the lower peak

nodes.title: Loaded box drop
nodes.procedure: Box loaded with the aircraft (or a ballasted spar-and-tube dummy first), 0.3 m flat drop and one bottom-edge drop; accelerometer taped on the spar at y 0; chalk on the lower and upper motor caps and foot pads (no mark on floor or lid)

nodes.title: Weigh the box empty and loaded
Handle pull test
nodes.procedure: Loaded box hung from each handle in turn for 1 min, then jerked 3 times from 50 mm slack; no pull-through, no dent
